text: answer[mkt-1788922492288-9f484d]: Tupac Shakur is dead. He was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later at age 25. This is settled fact confirmed by hospital records, a coroner's report, and his public funeral at Rampart Street Temple in Los Angeles on September 17, 1996. The "still alive" conspiracy theories that resurface periodically—tied to his 1995 and 1996 albums, which were recorded before his death and released posthumously in 1997—lack any credible supporting evidence. No verified photograph, video, or credible eyewitness encounter has surfaced in nearly three decades. The answer is Tuesday: Tupac has been dead since 1996.
